messages:
olga: deploy-bot flagged a canary failure for billing-api chart v5.4.0 in eu-central — image digest mismatch: pod pulls failing with image has different digest than promotion manifest. tagging @harry @sre-oncall. do we pin, rollback, or re-push image?
deploy-bot: Canary paused at 10%. Event: image pull failed "registry.internal/billing-api@sha256:aaaa..." expected digest not present in regional mirror. (bot)
registry-bot: Mirror sync report: primary registry has digest sha256:aaaa..., mirror eu-central shows sha256:bbbb... — a recent garbage-collection + push race produced different digest for same tag in region. Investigating.
harry: oh — the CI push retried during a GC window and re-pushed the image, resulting in a different manifest digest. promotion manifest referenced the primary digest. options: 1) re-tag/push to unify digests (risky), 2) rollback to v5.3.7 and pin region, 3) pin manifest to regional digest and re-promote when mirrors converge. I prefer option 2 for safety.
sre-oncall: agree rollback is safest to avoid user impact. rollback command: `deploy-bot promote --chart billing-api:5.3.7 --region eu-central --force-rollback && deploy-bot pin --chart billing-api:5.3.7 --region eu-central`
olga: if we rollback, make sure release-notes include the digest race and mirror GC window so teams can avoid pushing during GC. @release-bot please draft.
release-bot: Draft note added: "Rollback billing-api to v5.3.7 in eu-central due to regional registry digest skew caused by concurrent GC and re-push. Action: pin region and coordinate mirror verification before re-promote."
registry-bot: Mirror sync resumed — attempting to reconcile manifests. ETA to converge ~12m.
harry: given ETA, let's rollback now and pin. We'll re-open promotion once registry-bot confirms digest convergence and infra adds a pre-promotion mirror check. Filing follow-up: https://git.company/infra/issues/1023
olga: merging pin PR for promotion manifest now.
deploy-bot: Promotion executed: billing-api promoted to 5.3.7 in eu-central (forced rollback). Canary at 10% and healthy.
sre-oncall: monitoring — pods stable, no image pull errors.
release-bot: Release notes updated with rollback blurb and next steps.
harry: follow-up: add a pre-promotion gate: `regmirrorctl verify --all-regions --digest sha256:aaaa...` to CI. also schedule an infra note about avoiding pushes during GC.
olga: thanks all. recap: rollback + pin done, follow-ups filed, will re-promote when mirror confirms digest unify. ETA re-promote: after registry-bot confirms convergence. :white_check_mark:
